paragraphs.text: DSH Web UI plugin: a generated cue when a turn finishes and a different cue when the agent asks a qu
estion, with a composer mute, preview and volume control.
# dsh-finish-sound
DSH Web UI plugin that plays a short cue when a turn finishes, and a different cue when the agent as
that plays a short cue when a turn finishes, and a different cue when the agent asks you something.
- **Two events, two cues.** A finish cue plays when a turn ends in any session, not only the one on
screen. Subagent turns never ring the finish cue, so one parent turn rings once however many delegat
es it runs. A question cue plays when `ask_user_question` or an approval starts waiting for you. A r

un of queued turns only rings once, at the end.
- **One setting for every session.** Settings → Gene
ral → Event sounds turns both cues on or off for this browser, sets the volume and previews either c

ue.
- **Your own sounds.** Either cue can be replaced with an audio file of up to 2 MB and 10 second
s that the browser can decode (WAV, MP3, OGG, …). The file stays in this browser's IndexedDB; **Use

built-in** returns to the shipped clip.
- **Generated clips.** Both cues are WAV files generated wit
h MOSS-SoundEffect-v2.0 (Apache-2.0) and ship inside the plugin, so they play offline.
## Cues
| Event | Sound | Clip |

| Turn finishes | Two bright marimba notes one step apart | `assets/finish.wav` |
| Agent asks | Two
quick bright marimba notes going up, higher and softer than the finish cue | `assets/question.wav`
quick bright marimba notes going up, higher and softer than the finish cue | `assets/question.wav` |
Exact prompt and seed for each clip are in `CLIP_PROVENANCE` in lib/sounds.js.
## Install
Use the DSH plugin manager (Plugins → Add plugin) with the spec:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or install from the command line and add the bundle to the profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then add `"dsh-finish-sound"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` and res
tart `dsh web`. The package ships `cordis.patch.yml`, which inserts the loader entry; the browser ha
lf loads through the package's `dsh.client` declaration.
A prebuilt tarball is attached to the release:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
For a local checkout, `link:/path/to/dsh-finish-sound` works the same way.
## Behaviour
- Browsers keep audio locked until the page has had a user gesture. A cue that fires before then pla

ys on the next click or key press unless a new turn has already started.
- A snapshot that ends a tu

rn and asks a question at the same time plays the question cue only.
- A subagent Session never ring
s the finish cue. The parent turn rings once, when its own turn ends.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The browser bundle is generated. Replace a clip in `assets/`, edit `src/client.js`, then run `npm ru
n build`: `lib/sounds.js` embeds each clip as a data URL and `lib/client.js` registers the plugin mo
dule and that catalogue in one file, because the client module loader resolves only modules a bundle
t catalogue in one file, because the client module loader resolves only modules a bundle registered.
The clips were generated locally with MOSS-SoundEffect-v2.0 from the prompts and seeds in `CLIP_PROV
ENANCE` (the seed goes to the pipeline's `seed` argument), then mastered: 30 Hz high-pass, trim, fad
es, peak normalization, mono PCM16. The question cue is set to 80% of the finish cue's RMS.
